# Saibyl

> Saibyl builds a room of AI buyers from a founder's own material, puts the
> pitch in front of them, and reports every objection with the exact sentences
> behind it — before launch. One full evaluation is free, and no card is
> required for it.

Saibyl is a product of Saido Labs LLC.

A founder uploads a deck, or answers five short questions, and Saibyl assembles
a room of buyers from that material rather than from a template. The room reads
the pitch and reacts. What comes back is every objection, ranked by how much of
the room carried it, with the sentence each buyer actually said attached to it.
It is a rehearsal, not a survey.

## What it answers

- **Will buyers object to this, and to what?** Objections are ranked by reach,
  intensity and how widely they spread across different kinds of buyer, so the
  one that costs deals ranks above the one that is merely loudest. Every number
  traces back to a quote.
- **Is the idea already taken?** A clearance check searches registered
  trademarks, granted patents and pending applications, and reports what stands
  closest with the filing attached.
- **Why doesn't my website convert?** A website check reads a real page and
  returns what to change, with the page's own words as evidence. It judges the
  page a person sees and, separately, what a crawler or an assistant can read
  from it.

## What it does not do

- It does not survey real people, and it does not claim to. The room is built
  from the founder's own material and reasons from it; the product's own
  reports say so wherever a number appears.
- It does not report a score without the evidence under it. Every finding
  carries the sentence, the measurement or the filing it came from.
